attractions.name: Hall of Fame
attractions.description: Museum run by the Indian Army honouring soldiers who served and lost their lives in the region, with displays on the Kargil War and Siachen, uniforms, weapons, photographs and soldiers' letters. An evening Light & Sound Show is also held.
attractions.hours: 9:00 AM–1:00 PM and 2:00 PM–7:00 PM; closed Mondays
tips: Photography rules may vary within individual galleries; follow instructions on site

attractions._replaced_from: North India/Rashmi- Leh and Ladakh- All Inclusive Guide(1).docx

attractions.name: Spituk Monastery & Kali Mata Temple
attractions.description: Active Buddhist monastery on a hilltop, history dating to the 11th century, with views over the Indus Valley, river and airport. Contains a fierce protector deity also revered by Hindus as Kali Mata. About 7–8 km from Leh.
attractions.dress_code: Dress modestly, particularly when entering prayer halls
tips: Some areas may be closed during religious activities
Approach involves steps, take it slowly at altitude
Enjoy the hilltop views beyond the main prayer hall
attractions._source_file: North India/Rashmi- Leh and Ladakh- All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Gurudwara Pathar Sahib
attractions.description: Peaceful Sikh shrine built in memory of Guru Nanak Dev, named after the sacred stone associated with his 16th-century visit. Langar is open to everyone.
attractions.dress_code: Cover head, remove footwear before the prayer area, dress respectfully
tips: Visitors are welcome regardless of religion
attractions._source_file: North India/Final_Rashmi- Leh and Ladakh- All Inclusive Guide.docx
attractions._replaced_from: North India/Rashmi- Leh and Ladakh- All Inclusive Guide(1).docx

attractions.name: Magnetic Hill
attractions.description: Roadside spot where vehicles in neutral appear to roll uphill, generally explained as an optical illusion of the terrain.
tips: Let the driver demonstrate the phenomenon

attractions._replaced_from: North India/Rashmi- Leh and Ladakh- All Inclusive Guide(1).docx

attractions.name: Indus & Zanskar Confluence (Sangam)
attractions.description: Confluence of the Indus and Zanskar Rivers against bare Himalayan mountains; the contrast in water colour can sometimes be visible depending on season and water levels.
